code_object.interpretation: The aux reconstruction was already one packed dword load, and the four indexed codebook loads remain unchanged. The retained win is narrower: one explicit readfirstlane converts both per-lane 64-bit IQ3 weight-block address chains to wave-scalar arithmetic and lowers VGPR allocation 48->40 without changing loads, function size, or scratch.

eager_control_512_128.interpretation: Pair directions disagree and eager is host/launch dominated at about 114 ms/token. Treat this as flat noise, not a candidate performance claim; all generated tails, final ID 220, final logit, and memory are exact. The production one-step graph route is the performance scoreboard.

excluded_attempts.first_profile_launch: Excluded before measurement. Changing the parent IQ source changed the grouped-prefill cache tag; the first rocprof process attempted a nested hipcc build and was stopped. The dependent .so was prebuilt outside rocprof before the retained trace.

decision.rollback: Revert the single readfirstlane source hunk; no runtime flag is retained for a semantics-neutral source/codegen hint.
decision.reason: Bit-exact production math, zero private bytes, lower allocated VGPR, a repeatable 624-dispatch production-family reduction, Amdahl-consistent counterbalanced graph-wall gain, and exact/non-regressive 1K/4K controls satisfy the bounded D1C gate.
decision.campaign_result: D1A skipped as obsolete; D1B rejected; D1C retained. After this change the D0 ordering remains dense Q8, attention, dense Q6/lm-head, weighted IQ4, then IQ3, so task #15 stops rather than opening another IQ sweep.
